SELECT #{configKey} AS configKey, COUNT(*) AS cachedRows, MIN(exit_date) AS firstExitDate, MAX(exit_date) AS latestExitDate, MAX(updated_at) AS latestUpdatedAt FROM quant_bull_v4_replay_fact WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
